title: Task-2 traversal-order vs. dense-sampling coverage probe (experiment brief)
purpose: Reproducible experiment brief for testing whether the fixed plotline→character→beat→shot traversal in Task 2 (arXiv 2609.12769v3) produces better narrative coverage than a density-matched random-shot baseline, using the paper's own quiz-recall evaluation design. Companion to Scout's judge-bias probe (artifact de3a5ffc). Not executed.
